Detailed Description

Brick pyramid structure for multi-resolution hierarchical representation.

This file defines the Brick template class that represents a spatial brick as a pyramid of multiple levels of detail (LOD). Each brick contains nodes organized in a hierarchy from finest to coarsest resolution.
